name: Dance CV
tagline: Upload any solo dance video and learn it move by move with a webcam coach that scores you.
problem: Dance games score only a remote's position and cannot teach your own choice of dances.
solution: AI chunks the uploaded dance into learnable moves; pose tracking compares your movement and gives advice.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a dance, then dance in front of the webcam and get scored.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Fixes two flaws of a well-known dance game.

lessons: Name the game everyone played and what it got wrong.
